audience: marketing and print teams that review proofs in Ziflow

useCases.title: Find late proofs or proofs that need changes
useCases.text: Search proofs by name and status, for example proofs with changes required or late. Then read one proof's stages and deadlines.

useCases.title: Review open comments on a proof
useCases.text: List all comments on one proof, with their author, page and resolved state. Read one comment to see its replies.

useCases.title: Read the activity log of a proof
useCases.text: List who did what on a proof and when, optionally between two dates.

useCases.title: Add a comment and resolve a comment
useCases.text: Add a comment to a proof at a page. Every reviewer on the proof sees it. Resolve a comment, or reopen it.
